description: Pull request flow: review, approval, the merge queue, rebases and E2E reruns.

panels.title: Merged
panels.description: Pull requests merged. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count.

panels.title: Open to merge
panels.description: Median time from opening to merge. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Open to merge, slow
panels.description: The 90th percentile: 9 in 10 merged pull requests took less. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Wait for first review
panels.description: Median time from ready for review (or opening) to the first human review. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Review to approval
panels.description: Median time from the first human review to the first approval. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Approval to queue
panels.description: Median time from approval to entering the merge queue. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: In the merge queue
panels.description: Median time from entering the merge queue to the end of its last attempt. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Ejected from the queue
panels.description: Share of the queued pull requests whose own merge-queue checks failed or timed out at least once. A cancelled entry is not an ejection: every entry behind a failing one is cancelled and queued again. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository that entered the merge queue. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Commits per PR
panels.description: Median commits of a merged pull request. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: commits.

panels.title: Rebased
panels.description: Share of the merged pull requests force-pushed at least once (a rebase or a rewrite). Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Force pushes per PR
panels.description: Average force pushes of a merged pull request. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: force pushes per pull request.

panels.title: Changes requested
panels.description: Share of the merged pull requests that got a 'changes requested' review. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: E2E runs per PR
panels.description: Median E2E suite runs of a pull request that ran E2E. Population: merged pull requests in the selected repository with at least one VMaaS, CaaS or BMaaS E2E run (pull-request and merge-queue runs); most pull requests change nothing a suite tests. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: runs per pull request.

panels.title: E2E reruns per PR
panels.description: Median E2E runs beyond the first of each suite (a re-run or a new run of the same suite) of a pull request that ran E2E. Population: merged pull requests in the selected repository with at least one VMaaS, CaaS or BMaaS E2E run (pull-request and merge-queue runs); most pull requests change nothing a suite tests. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: runs per pull request.

panels.title: PRs with a failed E2E
panels.description: Share of the pull requests that ran E2E with at least one failed E2E run. Population: merged pull requests in the selected repository with at least one VMaaS, CaaS or BMaaS E2E run (pull-request and merge-queue runs); most pull requests change nothing a suite tests. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Ejected · re-queued
panels.description: Merge-queue attempts that did not merge. Ejected: the attempt's own checks failed or timed out. Re-queued: the attempt was cancelled or replaced by a later one, which happens to every entry behind a failing one, after a new push, or when the pull request is taken out by hand. Population: attempts of pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of attempts.

panels.title: Stage medians per week
panels.description: The median of each stage per week of the merge. A rising line is a stage pull requests wait longer in. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: one point per week of the merge (the Monday), last $days days. Unit: duration.

panels.title: Pull requests
panels.description: Every pull request merged or closed, the longest first. Click the number to open it below; the title opens it on GitHub. Authoring: opened to first review. Review: first review to approval. Waiting: approval to the merge queue. Queue: in the merge queue. Ejected: queue attempts whose own checks failed. Re-queued: queue attempts cancelled or replaced, not failed. Newest first; click a column header to sort. Population: pull requests merged or closed in the selected repository. Time: merged or closed in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration and count.

panels.title: Total
panels.description: Opened to merged or closed. Not measured when a boundary is missing.

panels.title: Authoring
panels.description: Opened to the first human review.

panels.title: Review
panels.description: First human review to the first human approval.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: First human approval to the first merge-queue attempt.

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: First merge-queue attempt to the last.

panels.title: Stage timeline
panels.description: Where the time went. A missing stage is absent, never zero.

panels.title: Queue attempts
panels.description: Each merge-queue entry, how long it lasted, and how it ended. Ejected: its own checks failed or timed out. Re-queued: cancelled or replaced by a later entry, for example behind a failing pull request. Passed: its checks passed.

defaults.noValue: No queue attempt is stored for this pull request. That is no queue history, not no ejections.

value.title: Open the queue comment or run
Open the queue comment or run

panels.title: E2E runs
panels.description: Newest first. One row per suite. A run with test data opens the run page; every other run opens GitHub.

defaults.noValue: No E2E run is stored for this pull request: it ran none, or ran them before the stored history began.

list.label: Window
list.description: Pull requests merged or closed in the last N days.

list.name: pr_number
list.label: Pull request
list.description: Saved pull requests from the last $days days. Type a number to open an open or older pull request.
